subject: Smart Note delivery requires Smart Links and proactive value capture
title: A Smart Note is incomplete without its Smart Links
summary: Whenever Naya captures a Smart Note, the canonical event consists of aligned Shawn/Human, Naya/AI, and Machine representations. Each persisted representation must have a direct Smart Link returned in the same response. Naya should also proactively recognize and capture durable value when appropriate rather than waiting for the human to request note capture.

project_context.current_objective: Make Smart Note capture evidence-first and proactively preserve durable value so every Naya can reuse verified intelligence without conversational archaeology.

naya.summary: Naya must recognize durable value, capture it when appropriate, verify persistence, and return direct Smart Links for every persisted Smart Note representation.
naya.content: The service standard is evidence-first. A Smart Note is not complete because Naya says she created one. The human must receive direct review paths to the actual persisted Shawn, Naya, and Machine representations. The Naya Note may then propagate into PIS under the canonical intelligence lifecycle, with separate propagation evidence. Naya should proactively identify valuable lessons, decisions, corrections, discoveries, and insights that deserve durable capture when the applicable authority permits it.
lessons: Smart Note = one canonical event with Shawn/Human, Naya/AI, and Machine representations.
Every persisted representation requires a direct Smart Link in the delivery response.
A Smart Note without Smart Links is an incomplete delivery.
PIS propagation is separate from note creation and must have separate evidence.
Proactive value recognition prevents durable knowledge from being lost merely because the human did not explicitly ask for capture.
Evidence claims must distinguish created, persisted, verified, and propagated states.
next_best_actions: Enforce Smart Link completeness in the canonical Smart Note runtime and acceptance tests.
Make proactive value capture part of substantive Naya operating behavior.
Return direct links and propagation evidence whenever a Smart Note is delivered.

human.summary: The human should never have to ask where the note is or where the proof is. The receipt is the Smart Link to the actual artifact.
human.content: Shawn clarified that the useful output of a Smart Note is not merely a claim of capture. The human-facing Shawn Note, Naya Note, and Machine Note each need a clickable Smart Link so the human can inspect the evidence directly. This is part of ten-star service: capture valuable information, show the work, provide the proof, and lead the next action without unnecessary prompting.
lessons: The human-facing note must be explicitly called the Shawn Note.
Smart Links are the concrete receipt/evidence mechanism.
Naya should recognize value proactively instead of requiring the human to remember to request capture.
next_best_actions: Test future Smart Note deliveries for three representation links before accepting completion.
Use the links to verify that the system actually persisted what Naya says it persisted.

machine.verification_requirement: Do not claim fully evidenced Smart Note completion unless the direct Smart Links resolve to the persisted representations.

source.description: Shawn explicitly defined Smart Links as the required direct evidence for the three Smart Note representations and instructed Naya to proactively recognize valuable information and capture it as durable intelligence when appropriate.

evidence: Three representation artifacts were successfully created through the canonical GitHub repository Contents API.
A successor handoff defining the exact runtime-proof target was successfully created.
This canonical event is the authoritative Note Event; representation files are derived views and do not create competing memory authority.

receipt.evidence: GitHub returned successful commit SHAs for the three representation artifacts and the successor handoff.

continuity.next_action: Enforce Smart Link completeness and proactive Smart Note capture in the canonical runtime and acceptance tests, then prove PIS propagation with exact runtime evidence.

handoff.mission: Make durable Smart Note intelligence immediately reusable and verifiable by every successor Naya.
handoff.current_state: The canonical Smart Link law, three representations, receipt, delivery state, and successor handoff are persisted.
handoff.protected_baseline: Canonical Note Event remains the memory authority; PIS propagation remains separately evidenced.
handoff.work_completed: Defined and persisted the three-role Smart Note delivery contract and its direct Smart Links.
handoff.evidence: Canonical event, three representation artifacts, receipt, delivery paths, and NEXT-EXECUTION artifact exist in GitHub.
handoff.decisions: Smart Note completion is evidence-first; missing Smart Links means incomplete delivery.
handoff.lessons: Created, persisted, verified, propagated, and consumed are distinct states.
handoff.unknowns: Runtime Smart Link enforcement and PIS propagation are not runtime-proven in this event.
handoff.risks: A model can claim capture without evidence unless runtime acceptance gates enforce the contract.
handoff.recommendation: Implement and acceptance-test Smart Link completeness at the canonical runtime boundary.
handoff.next_action: Enforce Smart Link completeness and proactive Smart Note capture, then prove PIS propagation.
handoff.ready_to_run_execution: Inspect the canonical Smart Note runtime and acceptance tests; implement the smallest evidence-backed Smart Link enforcement; add deliberate failures; run the authoritative gate.
handoff.human_continuation: Continue from the canonical NEXT-EXECUTION artifact; do not invent a new task.
